snippet.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition | July 20th | Release date & gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/

Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition brings the must-have role playing puzzle adventure to PC and PlayStation 4, as well as Nintendo Switch for the first time on July 20th.

To sharpen your weapons until launch, take a deep dive into what makes Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes gameplay so unique and deep. And download the demo during Steam Next Fest to ally with one of five mighty characters, leading their army in a variety of multiplayer modes to achieve top status on the battlefield.

#mightandmagic  #tacticalrpg  #rpg
